title: Reject skipped direct WebView smokes
summary: Make four canonical Node-backed WebView smoke wrappers fail when their only test evidence is skipped.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-SMOKE-FIRST-001. Raw unittest exits zero for prerequisite skips, so command-evidence, rename-readiness, row-detail, and schedule wrappers can be recorded as passing without executing JavaScript assertions.
behavior_before: The four wrappers propagate only unittest exit status; zero executed evidence with skipped tests returns success.
behavior_after: The four wrappers use a shared Node-only mode of the bounded WebView runner. It requires positive executed-test evidence, rejects any skip by default, preserves genuine unittest and timeout exit codes, supports explicit diagnostic-only AllowSkippedTests, and emits one structured outcome.
tests_added: Deterministic restricted-PATH tests invoke all four canonical wrappers with bundled PowerShell/Python and prove missing Node returns skipped_disallowed, a nonzero wrapper exit, positive discovered counts, and structured missing-prerequisite evidence.
Normal-environment tests invoke all four wrappers and prove positive executed counts, zero skips, and passed structured results.
Smoke-map parsing now covers the shared direct runner so canonical wrapper-to-module inventory remains drift-free.
